**裁决落档 + 认领(2026-08-06)。**

维护者已接受 PM 评估建议:
- **第 1-6 条采纳**,含三处修订:① 第 6 条(Guardrail 例外)措辞收紧——仅限维护者**明示授权**的 `.claude/` 内部工具 PR,授权出处必须引用在 PR 正文,复核仍需另一个座位或维护者,⛔不得自审自合;② 第 2 条补「**加行**」情形(新增座位行天然碰共享结构,同样先重拉再回读);③ 第 1 条第 6 步措辞改「清理**或随移交物转交**本会话定时器」。
- **第 7 条(结构瘦身)批准方向 + 三条纪律**:主文件留「规则 + 一行案例锚点」,只把长叙述案例抽到 `references/incidents.md`;**纯搬移零改写**;排在全部文本增补之后单独成 PR。瘦身后 `references/incidents.md` 为未来案例默认落点,主文件增长率归零。
- 补 `domain:devx`(同族先例 #5885)。

⚠️ **座位表相关条款(第 1 条步骤 4、第 2 条)暂缓定稿**:维护者正在重裁 #4604 的承载架构(单正文多写手 → 座位贴方案,讨论进行中)。这两条按重裁结果实施——若迁移,则第 2 条从「防覆盖纪律」升级为「单写手结构 + 残余纪律」,交接清单第 4 步改写目标同步更新。其余条款不受影响。

> 认领:维护者直接指令(同 #5885,授权原文引用于 PR 正文);**严格排 #5885(PR 1)之后**,同文件不并行;第 7 条单独 PR 收尾。

**Stale-claim probe (devx seat, session `session_01F8q5J1MQyocgtNspb15fSn`, 2026-08-08 12:3xZ).**

This card has carried `pm:dispatched` + an assignee for over 48 hours with **no remote branch** (`git ls-remote --heads origin | grep issue-5925` returns nothing) and no PR. Same for #4251 under the same assignee.

Per the stale-claim reclaim protocol: if this claim is still alive, reply here with the session ID and current state within the next window. Absent a reply, the devx seat will release the assignee and return the card to the queue — noting that **six queued cards (#6492 #6490 #6465 #6371 #6218 #6207) plus #6644 are currently excluded from dispatch solely because their deliverable shares this card's file surface** (`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`), so the cost of a dead claim here is seven cards' worth of queue stall.

A live branch with commits would cancel this probe on sight — none exists at probe time.

_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

**Stale-claim reclaimed** — assignee removed, `pm:dispatched` dropped, card returned to `pm:queue`. devx seat, session `session_01F8q5J1MQyocgtNspb15fSn`, 2026-08-08 13:1xZ.

Evidence, all three legs of the reclaim test:

1. **Age**: claimed since 2026-08-06 — over 48 h, against a ~24 h presumption threshold.
2. **No branch, no PR**: `git ls-remote --heads origin` shows no ref matching this issue; a full listing of `*skill*` branches turns up only unrelated ones (`claude/add-steedos-agent-skills`, `copilot/*`, etc.). A live branch with commits would have cancelled this on sight — there is none.
3. **Probe unanswered** (posted ~40 min ago on this thread).

⚠️ **The distinction that makes this a safe reclaim rather than a guess**: `os-zhuang` is **not** a dead session — that account posted triage comments today at 09:29Z, 09:30Z, 09:33Z and 10:22Z. So this is an *abandoned claim held by a live account*, not an account that went silent. Had the account itself been quiet I would have waited longer, since a resumable session can still land work; an active account that has not touched this card in 48 h is telling you the card was dropped.

If that session returns and disputes this: its claim predates mine, it has priority, and I yield immediately — nothing has been built on top of this reclaim beyond the label change.

**#4251 reclaimed on the same evidence** (same account, same 48 h+, no branch).

## What this actually unblocks — and an honest correction to my own earlier framing

I previously wrote that this claim was stalling seven cards and that reclaiming it would "unlock seven at once". **That was imprecise and I am correcting it here rather than letting it stand.** #6492, #6490, #6465, #6371, #6218, #6207 and #6644 all edit the *same file* as this card (`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`), so they were never going to be dispatchable in parallel with each other — reclaiming this card does not make them concurrent, it only makes the file surface workable at all.

The right shape for that family is what this card's own body already argued for in 2026-08-06 (「四单合并实施或严格串行」): **one sweep, one PR, N `Fixes`, per-item checklist review** — the packaged-promotion pattern, which amortises claim/PR/CI/acceptance overhead across the batch without diluting review. Noting that #5885 (the sibling this card coordinates with) is already **closed**, so the family has shrunk since filing and the surviving set must be re-measured before it is batched.

That sweep is the next dispatch from this seat, not a separate proposal.

Claim: PM loop round 5 (devx seat) — **SWEEP ANCHOR** for the `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` family

Container: M — `mode:subagent`, shared container.
Serial constraints cleared: this claim **is** the serialization. The whole family lands in one PR precisely because they cannot land in parallel; no other in-lane claim touches this file (the prior claim was reclaimed minutes ago on this thread, with evidence).

**Sweep members** (candidate set — the dev re-measures before writing, since the family has demonstrably shrunk: #5885 is already closed):

| card | contribution |
|---|---|
| **#5925** (this card, anchor) | 7 proposals from the spec lane's term — handover checklist, whole-body-replace trap, 3 API traps, `priority:p0`, standby posture, PM-tooling-PR exception |
| #6492 | `merge=os-regen` path list has drifted from `.gitattributes` (says eight, lists nine, file has ten) |
| #6490 | step 3: order batch selection by unlock fan-out |
| #6465 | a card unblocked BY a merge must re-verify its files AT the merged ref |
| #6371 | build the dependency closure before first verification in a fresh worktree |
| #6218 | consumption-radius scans use `'...pkg'` (prefix), not `'pkg...'` |
| #6207 | `enable_pr_auto_merge` arms without queueing on already-clean PRs |
| #6644 | 5 lessons from the `domain:metadata` seat's first term |

Sweep discipline per the packaged-promotion rules: **same class** (all are SKILL.md corrections/additions), **one PR, N `Fixes`**, a **per-item checklist in the PR body** (one line each: landing section | before | after) reviewed line-by-line rather than in diff order, and **zero changes beyond the N items** — `git diff --stat` must correspond one-to-one with the checklist. Members keep `pm:queue` but are **no longer dispatchable candidates** while this sweep is in flight; the N `Fixes` close them together on merge.

⚠️ Two things this sweep must NOT silently absorb: the anchor's **item 7** (extracting the long case narratives into `references/incidents.md` — explicitly "⛔ 不与前 6 条同 PR", maintainer's call), and anything that changes the loop's *behaviour* rather than its documentation. Out-of-scope discoveries get their own unassigned findings, per PD #10, which the packaging does not exempt.

**Un-dispatched, released, and kept OPEN deliberately** — devx seat, 2026-08-08 13:3xZ.

The sweep I dispatched from this anchor landed as **PR #6720**, and it correctly **excluded this card from its `Fixes` list**. The reason is a premise expiry that falsifies my own claim comment above:

**Items 1–6 of this card were already implemented and merged by PR #6029** ("Part of #5925(第 1-6 条)", merged 2026-08-06T23:55:44Z). The dev verified all six present in the current file — handover checklist, the whole-body-replace trap (now structurally gone, since the architecture moved to one sticker per seat), the three API traps (notes 13 and 3), `priority:p0`, the standby posture, and the PM-tooling-PR exception. The card's own "1571 lines" figure is the tell: the file is 2297 lines now.

So my claim comment's member table — which listed this card's "7 proposals" as sweep content — was **inherited from a stale card body and was wrong**. The dispatch instruction that saved it was "re-measure before writing, drop any member whose premise has expired and say so"; the dev did exactly that. Recording the error here rather than letting the claim comment stand uncorrected.

**Only item 7 survives**: extracting the long case narratives into `references/incidents.md` to cut the file's per-session load cost. This card marks it 「⛔ 不与前 6 条同 PR」 and the maintainer approved it as a separate pure-move PR. Closing this issue via the sweep would have discarded it — which is, exactly, the failure mode #6644 lesson 1 (landing in that same PR) exists to prevent. Nice symmetry: the sweep avoided the trap it was documenting.

**State now**: assignee removed, `pm:dispatched` dropped, back to `pm:queue` scoped to **item 7 only**. Whoever takes it should treat the body's items 1–6 as historical record, not as work.

⚠️ Note for that dispatch: item 7 is a pure move, and the file just grew by 166 lines in #6720 — so the extraction's cut points must be re-derived at claim time, never inherited from the card.

By the devx PM seat (session `session_01F8q5J1MQyocgtNspb15fSn`).

PR #6799 merged 2026-08-09 01:50Z as `Part of` this card, and it wrote **zero** new text against it — correctly. Items 1–6 were each verified present in the current file, landed by PR #6720 on 2026-08-06, which matches this card's own re-scoping comment ("items 1–6 are historical record, not work"). Writing them a second time would have been the exact defect the sweep exists to avoid.

What remains is **item 7 only**: extract the long incident narratives into `references/incidents.md`. The card itself excludes it from the same PR (「⛔ 不与前 6 条同 PR」), maintainer-approved as a separate pure-move PR — so its exclusion from #6799 was compliance, not an omission.

The card had been sitting on `pm:queue` **and** `pm:dispatched` simultaneously since the sweep completed ~14 hours ago. Under that pair it reads as in-flight to the lane view and as available to the queue view, and neither is true — nothing was in flight for it, and nothing could be claimed. Cleared to a single honest state.

⚠️ For whoever takes it: this is a **pure move**. The value is in the narratives leaving the hot file, so the discipline is that the moved text arrives byte-identical and the sweep surface (`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`) is this repo's hottest serialisation surface — check for an in-flight claim on it before dispatching, not after.
